source:
@@U01087@@
And I suggest you try using your head for a change! I need two weeks at minimum to sniff out opportunities.

@@U01089@@
Give me seven hours free and I assure you I'd need no Devil to help me seduce that little creature.

@@U01091@@
Ah, you almost sounded like a lascivious Frenchman! Just don’t let it get the better of you. Why rush into pleasure like any fool? You need to work it, this way, that way, knead your little puppet into shape, work her up with all sorts of wonderful nonsense, get her going— that’s when pleasure comes like a flood, as in the tales those randy Italians tell.

@@U01093@@
I have appetite enough without all that.

@@U01095@@
All right, let me give it to you bluntly. This little beauty of yours can’t be rushed; you don't take her kind by storm. So what do we do? We use our wits. We stoop, as they say, to strategy.

@@U01097@@
Get me something of hers, that angelic creature! Take me to her room! Bring me the kerchief she wears at her breast, a garter to excite my passion!

@@U01099@@
To prove how well I serve your anguish,
translation:
@@U01087@@
我建议你尝试用你的头脑来改变！我至少需要两周的时间来寻找机会。

@@U01089@@
给我七个小时的自由时间，我向你保证我不需要魔鬼来帮助我引诱那个小生物。

@@U01091@@
啊，你听起来简直像个淫荡的法国人！只是不要让它打败你。为什么要像傻瓜一样急于享乐呢？你需要这样、那样地工作，把你的小木偶揉捏成形，用各种奇妙的胡言乱语来激励她，让她继续前进——那时快乐就会像洪水一样涌来，就像那些好色的意大利人讲述的故事一样。

@@U01093@@
没有这些我就有足够的胃口了。

@@U01095@@
好吧，我就直白地告诉你吧。你的这个小美人不能操之过急；你不会对她的善良感到愤怒。那么我们该怎么办呢？我们用我们的智慧。正如他们所说，我们屈服于战略。

@@U01097@@
给我一些她的东西，那个天使般的生物！带我去她的房间！把她系在胸前的头巾拿给我，一条吊袜带来激发我的激情！

@@U01099@@
为了证明我能很好地缓解你的痛苦，
